### Purpose:
Adds a Full Node RPC validation tool that validates the get_block_spends, get_block_spends_with_conditions and get_additions_and_removals endpoints work on all blocks
<!-- Does this PR introduce a breaking change? -->
This PR introduces no breaking changes

### Current Behavior:
No tool to test endpoints across all blocks

### New Behavior:
There is a tool to test the endpoints across all blocks.
<!-- As we aim for complete code coverage, please include details regarding unit, and regression tests -->

### Testing Notes:
Increases code coverage by allowing rpcs to be tested against the real blockchain.

gold_comments.issue_summary:
```suggestion
    concurrent_requests = max(concurrent_requests, requests_per_batch)
```
I'm not sure what you intended by this division, but I imagine you'd want a lower cap on the batch-size
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The code uses `pipeline_depth` directly as the concurrency cap without ensuring it is at least `requests_per_batch`, risking underutilization or incorrect batching behavior.
gold_comments.rationale: A pipeline depth smaller than the number of RPCs per block (`requests_per_batch`) would cause sequential execution of per-block RPCs, defeating the purpose of concurrency and potentially skewing performance measurements.
